label: Study Identifier
derivation: DM.STUDYID

label: Unique Subject Identifier
derivation: DM.USUBJID

label: Subject Identifier for the Study
derivation: DM.SUBJID

label: Study Site Identifier
derivation: DM.SITEID

label: Planned Treatment for Period 01
derivation: DM.ARM

label: Planned Treatment for Period 01 (N)
derivation: DM.ARMNRS

label: Actual Treatment for Period 01
derivation: DM.ACTARM

label: Actual Treatment for Period 01 (N)
derivation: DM.ACTARMUD

label: Description of Planned Arm
derivation: DM.ARM

label: Description of Actual Arm
derivation: DM.ACTARM

label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
derivation: Date of first dose of study treatment per SAP: date of first dose at Week 0 (Visit 3). If SAP is silent, first exposure record (EX.EXSTDTC) where EX.EXTRT matches randomized treatment, sorted by EXSTDTC, EXSEQ; convert to date with partial-date imputation: sponsor convention - REVIEW

label: Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
derivation: Date of last dose of study treatment per SAP. If SAP is silent, last exposure record (EX.EXENDTC) where EX.EXTRT matches randomized treatment, sorted by EXENDTC, EXSEQ; convert to date with partial-date imputation: sponsor convention - REVIEW

label: Total Treatment Duration (Days)
derivation: TRTEDT - TRTSDT + 1

label: Age
derivation: DM.AGE

label: Pooled Age Group 1
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: Age category (<65, 65-80, >80). If AGE < 65 then '<65'; else if AGE <= 80 then '65-80'; else '>80'

label: Pooled Age Group 1 (N)
derivation: Numeric code for AGEGR1 in order of categories: 1='<65', 2='65-80', 3='>80'

label: Pooled Age Group 2
derivation: Not defined in SAP; set to null

label: Pooled Age Group 2 (N)
derivation: Not defined in SAP; set to null

label: Age Units
derivation: DM.AGEU

label: Sex
derivation: DM.SEX

label: Race
derivation: DM.RACE

label: Race (N)
derivation: Per study codelist - REVIEW

label: Ethnicity
derivation: DM.ETHNIC

label: Safety Population Flag
derivation: Per SAP Section 6: All patients randomized and known to have taken at least one dose of randomized drug. If randomized (DM.ARM ne '') and at least one EX record with EX.EXTRT matching randomized treatment and EX.EXSTDTC not missing then 'Y' else 'N'

label: Intent-to-Treat Population Flag
derivation: Per SAP Section 6: All patients randomized. If DM.ARM ne '' then 'Y' else 'N'

label: Efficacy Population Flag
derivation: Per SAP Section 6: All patients who were randomized and took drug, and have at least 1 post-baseline measure for both ADAS-Cog and CIBIC+. If ITTFL='Y' and SAFFL='Y' and at least one post-baseline ADAS-Cog and CIBIC+ assessment exists in efficacy datasets then 'Y' else 'N'

label: Completers Population Flag
derivation: Per SAP Section 6: All patients in the efficacy population who completed their Week 24 visit (Visit 12). If EFFFL='Y' and DS record with DSCAT='DISPOSITION EVENT' and VISITNUM=12 and DSDECOD='COMPLETED' then 'Y' else 'N'

label: Subject Discontinued Study Flag
derivation: If DS record with DSCAT='DISPOSITION EVENT' and DSDECOD ne 'COMPLETED' then 'Y' else 'N'

label: Subject Death Flag
derivation: DM.DTHFL

label: End of Study Status
derivation: From DS record where DSCAT='DISPOSITION EVENT' (SDTMIG). If DSDECOD='COMPLETED' then 'COMPLETED'; else if DSDECOD in ('ADVERSE EVENT','DEATH','WITHDRAWAL BY SUBJECT','PROTOCOL VIOLATION','LOST TO FOLLOW-UP','PHYSICIAN DECISION','SPONSOR REQUEST','OTHER') then 'DISCONTINUED'; else 'ONGOING'

label: Standardized Disposition Term
derivation: From DS record where DSCAT='DISPOSITION EVENT'. DSDECOD mapped to CDISC CT values per SAP Section 9.1

label: Reason for Discontinuation (Standardized)
derivation: From DS record where DSCAT='DISPOSITION EVENT'. DSDECOD mapped to CDISC CT values per SAP Section 9.1

label: Subject Reference Start Date/Time
derivation: DM.RFSTDTC

label: Subject Reference End Date/Time
derivation: DM.RFENDTC

label: Date/Time of Birth
derivation: DM.BRTHDTC

label: Duration of Disease (Months)
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: Duration of disease [computed as months between date of Week -2 (Visit 1) and date of onset of the first definite symptoms of Alzheimer's Disease]. Months between SV.SVSTDTC where VISITNUM=1 (Week -2) and MH.MHSTDTC where MHTERM indicates onset of first definite symptoms of Alzheimer's Disease, divided by 30.4375

label: Years of Education
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: Years of education. From QS where QSTESTCD='EDUYRS' or similar education test code at baseline, QSSTRESN

label: Baseline MMSE Score
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: Mini-Mental State. From QS where QSTESTCD='MMSE' and VISITNUM=3 (Week 0, Visit 3), QSSTRESN

label: Baseline BMI
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: BMI at Baseline (Visit 3 for weight and BMI, Visit 1 for height). Weight from VS where VSTESTCD='WEIGHT' and VISITNUM=3; Height from VS where VSTESTCD='HEIGHT' and VISITNUM=1; BMI = Weight(kg) / (Height(m))^2

label: Baseline BMI Category
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: BMI category (BMI<25, BMI 25-<30, BMI>=30). If BMIBL < 25 then 'BMI<25'; else if BMIBL < 30 then 'BMI 25-<30'; else 'BMI>=30'

label: Baseline BMI Category (N)
derivation: Numeric code for BMICAT in order of categories: 1='BMI<25', 2='BMI 25-<30', 3='BMI>=30'

label: Full Analysis Set Flag
derivation: Per LoT tables 14.1.1, 14.2.1, 14.3.1, 14.4.1, 14.3.5: Full Analysis Set population. If ITTFL='Y' then 'Y' else 'N'

label: Modified Intent-to-Treat Analysis Set Flag
derivation: Per LoT tables 14.3.1-14.3.4, 14.3.6, 14.3.7: Modified Intent-to-Treat Analysis Set. If ITTFL='Y' and SAFFL='Y' then 'Y' else 'N'

label: Pharmacodynamics Analysis Set Flag
derivation: Per LoT tables 14.4.1, 14.5.1: Pharmacodynamics Analysis Set. If SAFFL='Y' and at least one PK/PD assessment exists then 'Y' else 'N'
